latest.title: Failure of analyticity-radius growth in energy-canceling fluid models
latest.abstract: We prove that exact quadratic energy cancellation alone does not force growth of the spatial analyticity radius. On $\mathbb{T}^3$, we construct an explicit symmetric, translation-invariant, first-order bilinear operator $Q$ that preserves the divergence-free class and, for every smooth real-valued divergence-free vector field $v$, satisfies $ \int_{\mathbb{T}^3} Q(v,v)\cdot v\,dx=0.$ For every prescribed sufficiently small time $T>0$, the equation $\partial_t u-Δu=Q(u,u)$ admits a global smooth, real-valued, mean-zero, divergence-free solution $u$ such that $\operatorname{rad}(u(0))=\operatorname{rad}(u(T))=1$. The construction reduces the dynamics on an invariant cyclic-shear class to viscous Burgers and tunes a Cole-Hopf heat profile so that its nearest complex zero returns to its initial distance from the real torus. For every $1<α<2$ and every prescribed sufficiently small $T>0$, we also construct a symmetric sparse frequency set, its associated Fourier projection, and trigonometric-polynomial initial data for the projected dissipative surface quasi-geostrophic equation. The resulting unique global smooth solution $θ$ has infinite analyticity radius initially but satisfies $0<\operatorname{rad}(θ(T))\leq1$. An additively separated Fourier cascade yields coefficientwise exponential lower bounds, while uniform comparison estimates control the feedback interactions. Thus entire analyticity need not persist even from trigonometric-polynomial data. Together, the two constructions show that an exact energy identity alone does not determine the frequency geometry governing analyticity-radius growth.
latest.workSummary: 构造精确能量抵消但解析半径不增长的流体模型：先定义保持散度自由和二次能量恒等式的双线性算子，再限制到不变 shear 类并用 Cole--Hopf 显式解，最后嵌入稀疏 Fourier cascade 制造半解析半径失败。
latest.breakthrough: 证明二次能量守恒本身不足以保证空间解析半径增长，给出在相同能量结构下可精确制造解析半径回落的对称模型。
latest.limitations: 算子是专门构造的对称平移不变一阶双线性算子；反例说明逻辑不足，不代表标准 Navier--Stokes 必然出现相同半径行为。

steps.claim: 构造的双线性算子保持散度自由并精确抵消能量。
steps.route: 对 Fourier 符号施加对称、平移不变和 divergence-free 约束，直接计算三线性配对为零，得到 L2 能量恒等式。
steps.evidence: 第 2 节 Proposition 2.1（PDF 第 4--6 页）。

steps.claim: shear 子类在动力学下不变且可化为标量方程。
steps.route: 选择单方向 Fourier/shear 形式，使非线性耦合只保留一个周期变量；Proposition 2.3 验证该子类闭合，标量振幅满足可积分 PDE。
steps.evidence: 第 2 节 Proposition 2.3（PDF 第 8--10 页）。

steps.claim: Cole--Hopf 变换给出在指定时刻解析半径可控的精确解。
steps.route: 将正标量振幅变换为热方程解，使用核表示和正性确定初值/终值；解析范数的 Fourier 衰减直接由热核和变换参数计算。
steps.evidence: 第 2 节 Lemma 2.4、Propositions 2.5--2.6（PDF 第 10--15 页）。

steps.claim: 稀疏 cascade 把有限深度不稳定传成任意高频的解析半径失败。
steps.route: 在稀疏 Fourier 集上递归传递能量，Lemma 3.3--3.4 给出有限深度稳定和比较界；Proposition 3.5 拼接频率层，完成 Theorems 1.1--1.2。
steps.evidence: 第 3 节 Lemmas 3.2--3.4、Proposition 3.5（PDF 第 17--28 页）。

latest.aiEvidence: 作者明确说明使用 OpenAI ChatGPT GPT-5.6 进行语言编辑、组织、文献核对和探索性数学讨论，并说明模型曾对 Theorem 1.2 的构造提出初步想法；作者独立核验并重写证明。
latest.aiEvidenceSource: PDF 第 32 页 AI 使用声明（文本行约 1581--1588）。
latest.priorityReason: 论文聚焦流体方程，主要进展属于控制理论；排序综合考虑其与 PDE 机制、可复用估计、正则性和长时间行为的相关程度。
